name: Jan Theilmann
headline: Financial Analyst at Goldman Sachs
summary:
- Financial Analyst at GS Asset & Wealth Management
- Prev. Equity and FX Derivatives at GS Global Markets and UBS Investment Bank
- Master's in Finance from HEC Paris, Bachelor's in Business and Computer Science from TU Munich and NTU Singapore
- Passionate about investing across the private and public markets, portfolio management, quantitative finance

positions.title: Associate – Asset & Wealth Management – Financial Analyst
positions.description:
•	Investment advisor covering 100+ family offices, foundations, endowments and UHNWIs
•	Alternatives: Modelled J-Curve and market value dynamics of LP portfolios to size commitments or manage liquidity; assisted LPs on the due diligence of primaries, evergreens and co-investments across Buyout, Venture, Growth, Secondaries, GP Stakes, Credit, Real Assets and Hedge Funds; facilitated tail-end liquidity and secondary transactions between GS LPs to exit legacy stakes or rebalance portfolios
•	Multi-Asset Portfolio Management: Advised on strategic and tactical asset allocation and ran portfolio optimisations; advised on active and passive manager and security selection; executed portfolio rebalancings and FX hedging rolls
•	Brokerage: Pitched, priced and executed cash and listed, OTC or securitised derivative trades across asset classes; provided access to ECM and DCM flow; executed a $25mn collar and call writing single stock risk management trade
•	Lending: Originated margin loans and mortgages; ran loan-to-value simulations to size leverage or cover margin calls; worked on a $50mn car, mortgage and margin loan restructuring to lower interest costs and the odds of a margin call

positions.title: Off-Cycle Analyst – Global Markets Division – Swiss Cross-Asset Structured Product Sales
positions.description:
•	Proposed structured note ideas, rolls and restructurings to 30+ Swiss private banks, brokers and asset managers
•	Priced flow structures across yield enhancement, capital protection, enhanced participation and warrants (15+ a day) 
•	Priced more exotic structures such as bespoke stock or fund baskets, spreads, lookbacks and range accruals (2+ a day)

positions.title: Off-Cycle Analyst – Investment Bank – Foreign Exchange, Rates and Credit Structuring
positions.description:
•	Developed structured product ideas for 20+ corporate hedging, wealth management and family office clients
•	Priced structured FX and PM forwards and notes (4+ a day) and prepared product presentations (1-3 a week)
•	Proposed new payoffs in the CDL derivatives pricing language to expand UBS’ autocallable FX and PM notes offering

positions.title: Internships

•	BTPN (Jakarta, top 10 Indonesian bank by assets): Analysed credit risks of the pension, SME and micro finance units

company.description:
We aspire to be the world’s most exceptional financial institution, united by our shared values of partnership, client service, integrity, and excellence. 

Operating at the center of capital markets, we act as one firm, mobilizing our people, capital, and ideas to deliver superior results across our clients’ most complex challenges.

For 157 years, Goldman Sachs has delivered world-class execution on a global scale across our leading Global Banking & Markets and Asset & Wealth Management businesses. 

Apprenticeship is central to our culture, with hands-on coaching and access to leaders who bring decades of experience and expertise. With office locations around the world, we offer a broad range of career opportunities to those who insist on excellence and thrive on performance.
